title: feat: add GLM-5.3 Flash
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash` as a publisher-qualified canonical model with no aliases.
- Pins OpenRouter to the exact `z-ai/fp8` route with provider fallback disabled.
- Sets `paidOnly: true`, multiplier `1`, and verified rates: $0.075/M input and image tokens, $0.015/M cached input, and $0.25/M output.
- Advertises text and image input, tools, mandatory reasoning, 10 reference images, and a 1,048,576-token context window.
- Updates `MODEL_SLUGS.md`, pricing snapshots, canonical-ID retrieval, resolver, reasoning, alias, and billing coverage.

Verified directly and through authenticated local E2E: streaming/non-streaming, tools, JSON object mode, reasoning, 10 images, prompt caching, exact billing, paid-only access, cache hit without a second debit, invalid input, and a 5-request burst.

No Pollinations GPU and no fallback.

gist.headline: A Flash in the Hive
gist.blurb: GLM-5.3 Flash has landed with a very large context window and room for ten reference images. Polli checked the route twice; it goes exactly where it says it goes.
gist.summary: Added the paid-only `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash` text model via a pinned OpenRouter `z-ai/fp8` route, with mandatory reasoning, tool use, text and image input, 10 reference images, and a 1,048,576-token context window.
gist.impact: Paid API users can now run GLM-5.3 Flash for long-context, reasoning-heavy multimodal work at verified rates of $0.075/M input or image tokens, $0.015/M cached input, and $0.25/M output tokens.
gist.visual_concept: Depict GLM-5.3 Flash as a cozy, precise lightning-fast library terminal: a huge glowing scroll represents the million-token context window, while ten tiny framed reference images float around it. Polli, wearing little librarian glasses and a tool belt, carefully routes a glowing cable into one clearly labeled OpenRouter socket; a code-plant and small flowers make the giant technical task feel like a well-tended garden.
